commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/ppo_m88_wheel_masked_friction_aux_driver.json --episodes 60 --seed 9310 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1200 --ridge 0.1 --run-dir runs/m91b_input_observability_formal_seed9310
commands.name: formal_input_observability_probe

decision_rule: Use M91-B to decide whether the current wheel profile has observable future-envelope information. Treat P1 as useful only if P1 improves over P0 on held-out future-envelope targets and the response-only P1-vs-P0 delta is positive on at least two of three targets.
failure_criteria: P1 wheel response has no held-out improvement over P0 on future-envelope targets
response-only P1-vs-P0 lift is not positive on at least two of three targets
the result cannot separate response-branch signal from context overfitting
hypothesis: With more samples and a formal split, wheel response should improve future handling-envelope observability over the no-wheel minimal profile if it contains useful self-ID information.
success_criteria: P1 improves over P0 on held-out future-envelope targets
response-only P1 improves over response-only P0 on at least two of three targets
profile conclusions are based on paired train/test splits, not PPO tuning
negative results are recorded and used to decide whether cleaner raw wheel dynamics are needed
